assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The CPT code for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is 93229.
The monitoring was ordered to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management.
The monitoring was documented in the clinical indication note.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered.
The member retains the right to appeal this determination.
